name: Circle City Plumbing
hoursText: Monday-Friday: 7am to 6pm, Saturday: 8am to 2pm, Sunday: closed

profile.service_area: Indianapolis and anywhere within about 25 miles: Carmel, Fishers, Greenwood, Plainfield, Avon, Lawrence, Beech Grove.
profile.emergency: Yes - 24/7 emergency service for active leaks, burst pipes, sewage backups and no-water situations. After-hours calls have a $95 after-hours fee on top of the normal trip charge.
profile.pricing: $79 trip/diagnostic charge, waived if you go ahead with the repair. Flat-rate pricing quoted on site before any work starts. Free estimates on water heater replacements and repipes.
profile.guarantees: 1-year labor warranty on all repairs; manufacturer warranty on parts and water heaters (6-12 years depending on model).
profile.credentials: Licensed Indiana plumbing contractor, fully insured.
profile.policies: We accept cash, card, and check. We install Bradford White and Rheem water heaters and Navien tankless. We don't do septic pumping or well pumps.
